b.x: This is not laboratory physics and not a diagnosis. The table is the calibration map the site already uses. The sum is open to be revised. This page does not dial.

Frequency, on this site, is not the hertz of a device pointed at the domain. There is no meter on the page. The number is the Hawkins map the channel already teaches: shame 20, fear 100, courage 200, reason 400, love 500, peace 600. Below 200 the state drives. From 200 the person chooses the next act. The sum below asks only this: which state this site trains, if it is read as it is written, and not as an end-of-the-world film.

Five doors that save a minute — stroke, first aid, water, an elder, the first no on the street — weight five, tone 450: reason with care. Three doors of the house — the pantry, the number, fire outside — weight three, tone 380: acceptance with a sum. Three doors of conduct — discretion, ego, intention — weight three, tone 300: neutrality on the way to willingness. Two doors of collapse — the month without power, read as a plan and not as fear — weight two, tone 350. Two doors of consciousness without a stage — weight two, tone 500. Sum 5,990. Weights 15. 5,990 divided by 15 is 399. The map has no 399. The whole step is 400. Reason.

The center is 400. The band where the site actually operates runs from 200 to 500. 200 is the floor: the courage of one act despite the tremor. Leave, stop, do not give the second yes, recognize one side of the body that failed. 500 is the ceiling the page practices: care without possession. The elder at their pace. The child. The person in the bed. The site does not live at 100, fear, although it describes fear so the person does not live in it. The site does not live at 700, enlightenment on the map. Whoever fakes 700 on a Tuesday drops to pride, 175, and pride is still force.

The number does not save. The act at step 200 or above saves. A person who recognizes slurred speech and a weak side in the first minute. One who does not walk into rising water. One who does not drag an elder. One who does not follow the polite request to the second place. A house with water that can be drunk and a medicine that was not stopped on one's own. That is this site's capacity. It is not infinite. It does not replace a doctor, a firefighter, or the law. One life already justifies the text. Frequency only matters because, at 100, the person sees the headline and does not see the side of the face.

Consciousness, here, is not jumping to 600. It is noticing the step you are on and climbing one. The site expands when it takes the person out of the rehearsal of the end and returns Tuesday: the plate, the medicine, the short sentence, the silence that is not flight. Repeated fear creates more of the same. Reason opens the sum. Care opens the hand. If the reading only increases fear, the frequency of the session fell to 100, even if the page is written at 400. The tone is not in the server. It is in the state of the one who reads. The site offers 400. The reader chooses whether to stay there.

Energy, here, is not a current coming out of the domain. It is what remains in the body after the reading. At 100, energy contracts: the person spends the day seeing threat, buys what they will not eat, and arrives at the real hour already tired. At 400, the energy stays usable. There is a next step, and the step fits on a Tuesday. What this site adds is not a title or a personality. It adds a sentence for the street, a sum for the house, an eye for the stroke, and permission not to live inside the headline. The person does not leave larger. They leave less scattered. Less scattered is more alive. That is what 400 delivers: quiet strength, without the spectacle of fear and without the spectacle of light.

The intention of this site in the life of the one who enters is one intention, in two halves. The first: that the person stay alive when the water, the power, the street, or the body fails. The second: that they do not pay for that life with the head down in fear. 400 is the number of that intention. Reason, to see the fact. Courage, at 200, for the act. Care, at 500, for the one who walks more slowly. It is not an intention to frighten. It is not an intention to make a hero. It is not an intention to sell an end. It is an intention to leave, in the person, the next true act, and the hand still extended to the one beside them. If one life stays because of that, the frequency has done what it had to do.
